description: Project Profiles. Lets a project flex report presentation per firm/standard while keeping data canonical. Phase 1 scope: PDF cover title + subtitle + footer, CSV column headers, email subject template. Inherits via `base:` + shallow merge at the export.* key level. Capture-form labels + vocabulary packs are intentionally NOT in this phase.

profiles.name: Default — SiteShrimp general
profiles.description: SiteShrimp default. Generic cover title, standard column headers, general-purpose email subject. Everyone starts here; no opt-in needed.

profiles.name: BCA CONQUAS (Private Residential) — R1 2026
profiles.description: BCA CONQUAS Private Residential R1 framework (effective 1 April 2026). NC-focused cover, tier language, projection-only disclaimer in the page footer. Use for CONQUAS assessments that will be reviewed by an accredited checker.

pdf.footerNote: Projection only — final assessment rests with the accredited checker, QP, or assessor. Weighted Project NC rate per R1 §3.3: IF × 0.4 + FT × 0.4 + EF × 0.2.

profiles.name: HDB BTO Handover
profiles.description: Room-by-room handover checklist format for HDB BTO defects. HDB-style terminology (Defect Item, Room, Remark) and a handover-focused cover.

pdf.footerNote: Defects raised during handover inspection. Please rectify within the stipulated DLP period.

profiles.name: Simple A4 Summary
profiles.description: Minimal single-sheet defect summary. Compact headers, no footer disclaimer. Good for weekly site walks where a full report is overkill.
